visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses, wearing a dark grey hoodie and a black backpack, performs frantic, exaggerated arm-waving and jumping motions on a wooden boardwalk. Behind him, a massive circular wooden structure is populated by numerous distant silhouettes against a purple and pink sunset sky. Yellow captions with a black outline are centered on the screen. (2) A second man wearing a light blue denim jacket is shown in a medium shot, holding a red-and-blue plush toy. He talks to the camera with an amused expression while the first man continues his eccentric movements in the background. The boardwalk environment includes low-lying green and purple plants and a metal railing. (3) The first man reappears, now wearing a black face covering and his glasses, adjusting the mask while looking closely at the camera. The scene transitions to a long shot of the two men running away from the camera down the long walkway toward the bright orange horizon of the sunset, their silhouettes shrinking in the distance.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A prominent, large-scale modern wooden circular structure (The Grand Roof) at the Osaka Expo 2025 site, a long pedestrian walkway with metal railings, and a field of low-growing plants under a vivid sunset sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male shouting and rapid speech dominate the opening. An upbeat electronic BGM with a consistent synth beat and steady percussion starts immediately. The vocal tone is exaggerated and comedic. (2) The audio shifts to a casual conversational interplay between two male voices. The BGM remains as a background bed. Occasional high-frequency digital SFX occur during text transitions. Ambient wind noise is faint. (3) A distinct, medium-frequency electronic buzzing SFX ('嗡嗡聲') is introduced to simulate a mosquito, followed by a humorous reaction from the speaker whose pitch rises in mock surprise. (4) The sequence concludes with loud shouting ('跑啊!') and heavy breathing, synchronized with a swell in music intensity. Fast-paced dialogue continues until a sudden hard cut ending.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedy Skit -> Mock Interview -> Climax/Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers through a humorous travel vlog snippet, using exaggerated physical comedy and mock dialogue to highlight the environment of the Osaka Expo 2025 site (specifically joking about the abundance of mosquitoes).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is filmed at the Osaka Expo 2025 site and features the official mascot plush (Myaku-Myaku), serving as a promotional lifestyle clip for the event.
